data.name: Voice of Chernobyl
data.detailed_description:
Voice of Chernobyl is a Multiplayer First-Person Survival and Shooter based in the European world where you try to survive and fight for either peace or to stand first place victorious

IF YOU'RE STILL NOT SOLD ON THIS GAME

Then listen to what people who've tried this game think and honestly say about it!

"What do you think of Voice of Chernobyl?":

"This game is pretty dope so far! Really fun with friends and family, ha-ha!" - Paul

"If sexual and psychological horror were combined into one thing." - Also Paul, after a month

BIZARRE AND DISTINCTIVE ADVENTURES

Each session can vary in all sorts of ways, you're given the capability to use interesting choices of weapons in various ways, and communicate against other people or to fend off certain beings

UNIQUE GAMEMODES

Some lit gamemodes, like Survival | Deathmatch | Team Deathmatch | Melee Fight | Arms Race | Infection. They each contain their own interesting maps (each game mode requires at least 2 players to play

NO MICROTRANSACTIONS

Completely free - Do you need new weapons? Then just play the game as you earn certain points for free to acquire new weaponry to dominate and be the nemesis of your enemies

FREE CUSTOMIZABLE CHARACTERS

Make your self indistinguishable from others by just playing the game! You do not need to pay anything at all, earn free presents when a round ends, open them for free, earning you a random type of clothing with a random effect or colour. Make your own personal character to be unique from others!

WORKSHOP MODDING SUPPORT

Of course you're given the ability to mod! Try out add-ons that can replace existing content to make it different, or that are in addition to the base game so you can play with whatever you want, your creation is your limit

NO NEED FOR DLSS, RTX OR ANY 'FRAME GENERATION'

Don't worry! The game has been optimized to the point where you can run it on 13+ year old laptops. You don't need DLSS, RTX or any fake frame technology, the options include settings that modify the look of the game to run on any device that should be able to run Steam

AND A LOT MORE

Such as experimental 64 player servers (your pc might blow up though), the gibbing system on enemies, and more (like a helicopter you can crash if you want or an apple juice).

Download now and play for free!

*Made with love <3*

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (version 21H1) 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Celeron N3060 1.60GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics Card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 720p 30hz cap with lowest settings is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (version 21H1) 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 3.3 Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 650
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p 75hz with highest settings is recommended.
